summary: VSE Corp filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting held May 7, 2026. Four routine proposals were voted on: election of eight directors (all elected with majority support), ratification of Grant Thornton LLP as independent auditor (99.9% for), a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation (approved with ~78% of votes cast in favor), and approval of an amendment to the certificate of incorporation to authorize blank check preferred stock. This filing is a standard annual meeting results disclosure with no special situation event, no M&A, activist, or restructuring activity, and no abrupt management change. The filing is purely informational and procedural.
